question: How should Kuṇḍalī be invoked at the end of the Bhairava word with the given syllables?
premises: The syllables paṃ and phaṃ are specified.
The placement is at the end of the word bhairava.
Kuṇḍalī is included following the previous supreme pattern.
inference: One should invoke Kuṇḍalī with paṃ and phaṃ at the end of the Bhairava word as before.
plain_english: Use paṃ and phaṃ at the end of the word Bhairava with Kuṇḍalī, as before in the supreme manner.
